cases.purpose: A busy mapping remains without --retry and is removed with --retry after its holder closes it, reporting only busy attempts as LVM2 dmsetup does. Missing device nodes fail the fixture.
cases.script:
export BASHOS_DMSETUP_ALLOW_MUTATE=1
name=qual-retry-$$
cleanup() { [[ $holder ]] && kill "$holder" 2>/dev/null; [[ $holder ]] && wait "$holder" 2>/dev/null; /usr/sbin/dmsetup --noudevsync remove "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1; rm -f ready retry.err; }
trap cleanup EXIT
dmsetup create --noudevsync "$name" --table '0 8 zero' || exit 1
node=
for f in /sys/block/dm-*/dm/name; do
  [[ -r $f ]] || continue
  read -r n < "$f"
  if [[ $n == "$name" ]]; then node=/dev/${f#/sys/block/}; node=${node%/dm/name}; break; fi
done
[[ -b $node ]] || { echo 'prerequisite: /dev/dm-N unavailable' >&2; exit 1; }
( exec 7<"$node" || exit 1; : > ready; sleep 2 ) & holder=$!
for ((i=0;i<100;i++)); do [[ -e ready ]] && break; sleep 0.02; done
[[ -e ready ]] || { echo 'holder failed' >&2; exit 1; }
if dmsetup remove --noudevsync "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'removed busy device without retry' >&2; exit 1; fi
# LVM2 dmsetup reports each busy attempt of --retry; only those lines may appear.
dmsetup remove --noudevsync --retry "$name" 2>retry.err || exit 1
[[ -s retry.err ]] || { echo 'no busy attempt reported' >&2; exit 1; }
while IFS= read -r line; do
  [[ $line == "device-mapper: remove ioctl on $name  failed: Device or resource busy" ]] || { echo "unexpected retry diagnostic: $line" >&2; exit 1; }
done < retry.err
wait "$holder" || exit 1
holder=
if /usr/sbin/dmsetup info "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'device remains' >&2; exit 1; fi
printf 'busy retry succeeded\n'
cases.oracle: The kernel-backed device node is independently located in sysfs and held open by a separate process. Removal must fail while busy without retry, succeed after the holder closes with retry, and the system dmsetup query must confirm the mapping is absent.
